title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Rate Card — Repeat-Lateness Loading on the Payoff Accrual Rate
content:
On the payoff of a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account that has been repeatedly late, the repeat-lateness loading is added to the payoff accrual rate — the monthly percentage at which the interim payoff accrual runs — and the rate never falls below zero.

| Late payment charges posted on the account in the last 12 months | Days past due on the latest closed statement | Repeat-lateness loading |
|---|---|---|
| At least 2 | At least 15 | 0.25 percentage points (high loading) |
| At least 2 | Fewer than 15 | 0.10 percentage points (low loading) |
| Fewer than 2 | Any | Zero |

The 12 months are whole calendar months counted back from the payment date, and every late payment charge on the account posted in that window counts.

## Boundaries (hypothetical, Commercial Account Net 30 at 2.00 percent)

- 2 late payment charges in 12 months, latest statement 15 days past due: loading 0.25, payoff accrual rate 2.25 percent.
- 2 late payment charges, latest statement 14 days past due: loading 0.10, rate 2.10 percent.
- 1 late payment charge, latest statement 40 days past due: no loading, rate 2.00 percent.
